text: Beginning August 4, 2026, GitHub Spark no longer accepts new users or allows the creation of new apps. Existing users can continue to access GitHub Spark until August 31, 2026 to export apps they’ve already created. Apps you’ve already deployed will continue to work after GitHub Spark is retired. Separately, GitHub Models, the inference service used by Spark’s llm() function, retired on July 30, 2026. As of that date, calls to llm() no longer work. Apps that don’t use llm() aren’t affected by the GitHub Models retirement.
